system.description: The Motion Sensing Visor tracks movement and highlights moving objects with color-coded warnings. This allows the wearer to see moving opponents with ease, even those attempting to be stealthy. The wearer of this visor gains a +5 Equipment bonus to Perception checks against targets that have moved at least one square since the wearer's last turn. However, a Motion Sensing Visor can be disorientating, especially in the heat of combat, and a character must spend two additional Swift Actions to use the Recover Action when attempting to move up the Condition Track. A Motion Sensing Visor cannot be worn at the same time as Armor with a helmet or any other device worn on the head.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
